title: Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Second Amendment to Contract DA-5697 with Jacobsen/Daniels Associates LLC: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of February 6,
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Second Amendment to Contract DA-5697 with Jacobsen/Daniels Associates LLC: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of February 6, 2029, and increase the contract authority by $1,500,000, for new total not to exceed $4,500,000, covering real estate consulting, acquisition, and right-of-way services for Los Angeles World Airports (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: Approval of the Second Amendment to Contract DA-5697 with Jacobsen/Daniels Associates LLC.
